title: Boaz Marries Ruth
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who stops to wonder, and tonight's story ends in a wonder nobody saw coming: a sad, empty Naomi holding a baby boy in her arms.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because this story ends in a wonder, and Wren never hurries past a wonder. In Wren’s world today: the little seeds she planted weeks ago looked like nothing but dirt. She watered them anyway, every single morning. Today a green sprout poked up, and then another. Wren crouched down close and whispered, “Look what was happening the whole time!” Just like Naomi holding baby Obed, Wren learned that Heavenly Father is growing good things even on the days we can’t see them.
